target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, current desktop ISO with writable disposable disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-current-2026-11-11.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-cold
verified: Span opened and rendered its bridge workspace.
A mass was visibly added, saved to /Home/Span/Game.DATA, and the chooser listed Game.DATA after New.
The file chooser was navigated from the selected Span directory to Game.DATA with two Down keypresses; Open restored the saved mass.
Shift+Escape returned to a working terminal and the Strut integration smoke check passed.
After flushing the disposable disk and cold-booting with the ISO detached, Open restored the saved mass again.
follow_up: The prior failure came from pointer-coordinate selection in the acceptance script. Keyboard navigation passes same-run and cold disk-only save/new/open.
scope_note: Current-image QEMU observation only; no live UTM or Pi hardware claim.
